task: Choose the highest-value set of indivisible tasks under a 10-unit budget. A costs 6/value 9; B costs 5/value 8; C costs 4/value 6; D costs 3/value 4.

evidence.text: A: cost 6, value 9. B: cost 5, value 8. C: cost 4, value 6. D: cost 3, value 4.
Budget: 10 compute units. Tasks are indivisible.
